description: Real progress: the verifier mutation-tested each check and six now hold discriminating coverage; four of AC 2's five named cases are genuinely real. Five blocking findings remain: the execution check has no evidence path at all so doctor cannot reach PASS on evidence; the boolean escape hatch survives and is the candidate's own only passing path; the gutted-_require control still yields zero red tests; AC 4 cannot go red for a write (an injected file write went undetected across 189 tests); AC 3's primary clause unproven for a third cycle.
Repeated-rejection attention threshold: 3 verifier rejections for this BIU. Judgment owner: coordinator.

Coordinator convergence assessment, cycle 3: 'Converging, and the contract change is working - but the producer is shipping tests that cannot fail, and that is now the only thing blocking this BIU.' Two items have survived two cycles unrepaired. The direction adds a method requirement addressed to the PRODUCER, not the verifier: 'For every test you add or rely on, delete or neuter the code it covers and confirm the suite goes red. Run that check yourself before publishing the candidate - the verifier is already running it, and three cycles have now been spent discovering the answer at verification time instead of implementation time.' Stated as the existing contract discipline applied earlier, not as new scope.

The producer's provider account exhausted its usage quota mid-invocation. The provider returned turn.failed - 'You've hit your usage limit ... try again at 6:22 PM'. No result marker was posted, so the dispatcher recorded DURABLE_RESULT_MISSING. The worker was mid-edit on tests/installation/test_doctor.py with the suite at 33 passed / 2 failed. SWF-09 anticipates this: for CLI providers token and monetary budget are measured, not hard-enforced, so exhaustion surfaces as a dead invocation rather than a clean budget refusal.
Durable attention item: DURABLE_RESULT_MISSING recorded, the factory loop cannot resolve it. The observation carries requires_model_judgment=true.
Durable attention item: DURABLE_RESULT_MISSING recorded, the factory loop cannot resolve it. The observation carries requires_model_judgment=true.

Liveness reconciliation was suppressed for this lane rather than re-emitting the trigger. Relaunching would start a producer that hits the same quota wall within minutes and would keep doing so every grace period. The durable attention item stays open and recovery resumes only on explicit resolution. This is the SWF-29 rule produced by PY-07's incident, applied to a condition PY-07 did not contain.

Worktree 63097907-ffb9-411c-a59c-d353c09e8a7e retains real uncommitted content - doctor.py, test_doctor.py and test_doctor_evidence.py, 65 insertions / 60 deletions. Under SWF-30 condition 6 that makes it required evidence and exempt from routine cleanup. The PY-06 retention rule applied to partial work rather than to a candidate.

Coordinator: 'This needs an operator decision, not a repair.' Options stated: wait for the quota reset (roughly nine hours), add provider credit, or run the PRODUCER on the claude adapter, which this installation already uses for the VERIFIER under a separate subscription. Changing a worker's provider is a profile change with budget implications under SWF-09 and is explicitly not a coordinator decision. No lifecycle state was changed.

Founder authorized running the PY-09 PRODUCER on the claude adapter for this recovery only. Contract, scope, acceptance criteria, baseline and cycle number unchanged - this continues cycle 4 and is not a new repair cycle. elapsed_seconds measures the interrupted invocation's end 02:12:46Z to this authorization 02:21:38Z. This is the first genuine human decision required by any BIU in PY-05..PY-09.

The capacity incident is the only place in PY-05..PY-09 where actor provider identity becomes durable: the PRODUCER adapter is codex under provider-default funding, and the VERIFIER runs on the claude adapter under a separate subscription. This is stated by the coordinator for PY-09. The dispatcher state record carries no provider field for any invocation, so the same assignment in PY-05..PY-08 is an inference and is recorded as UNKNOWN there.
